question_text: Which of the following statements best describe the Agile Manifesto? Select all that apply.

answers.answer_text: The Manifesto captures Agile’s values and reinforcing principles to support Agile project management planning and processes.
The Manifesto lays out a software development process that is flexible and focuses on people.
The Manifesto establishes a new approach that proves the Waterfall model wrong.
The Manifesto helps project managers and stakeholders focus on end products and deliverables rather than on users.

question_text: Fill in the blank: The Agile Manifesto emphasizes _____ over processes and tools.
How many values and principles make up the Agile Manifesto?
Which of the following projects are best suited to an Agile approach? Select all that apply.

answers.answer_text: Projects with clear client expectations that face minimal uncertainty
Projects that are complex and fast-paced
Projects that are susceptible to change or uncertainty
Projects with a set design and goals that are unlikely to change

question_text: Fill in the blank: VUCA is an acronym that stands for volatility, uncertainty, complexity, and _____.
Which of the following statements about Scrum are true? Select all that apply.

answers.answer_text: Scrum refers to a specific Agile framework that features teams working closely together to get the project across the finish line, like players in a rugby match.
Scrum refers to a football team’s protective equipment.
Scrum gets its name from a formation in rugby where all of the players lean forward, lock their heads together, and get possession of the ball so they can gain precious yards and score.
Scrum is an acronym for the processes that make up the Agile methodology.

question_text: What are some takeaways from the Spotify example? Select all that apply.

answers.answer_text: Don’t be afraid of trial and error.
Adapt based on your team’s goals.

question_text: What are the roles within a Scrum Team? Select all that apply.
Which Agile methodology provides transparent visual feedback to everyone who might be interested in the status of work in progress?
Fill in the blank: Agile project management is _____; the team operates within many short blocks of time where deliverables will evolve and improve depending on the feedback received.
In Agile, how are processes streamlined to reduce waste? Select all that apply.

answers.answer_text: By reducing time spent on unwanted features

question_text: As a project manager, you notice that your team members are spending a lot of time writing comprehensive documentation which contributes to a delay in delivering working software. What can you do to help your team recover from this and get back on track?

answers.answer_text: Remind your team that while documentation is important, it is more important to produce working software
Remind your team that documentation is not important, and only working software brings business value
Ask your team to work more hours to make up for the time spent writing documentation
Let your team know that you will take over the documentation effort so that they can focus on producing working software

question_text: How do Agile teams collaborate with their business partners and stakeholders to create business value for the organization and their users? Select all that apply.

answers.answer_text: Gather feedback at the end of the project only
Work together with business people and developers throughout the project
Help each other achieve the best outcome

question_text: As a project manager, you identify that your business plan may face major disruptive changes and a high degree of uncertainty. Which project management methodology should you follow?

answers.answer_text: Both Waterfall and Agile can work
Neither Waterfall nor Agile will work

question_text: How can the VUCA concept help you decide to use Agile or Waterfall? Select all that apply.

answers.answer_text: It helps determine whether your project is too volatile for the Waterfall method.
It helps determine how complex your project is.
It helps determine if your project needs more predictive stability than the Waterfall method provides.
It helps determine if your project is too ambiguous for the Waterfall method.

question_text: Where does Scrum get its name? Select all that apply.

answers.answer_text: Scrum is an acronym for the processes that make up the Agile methodology.
Scrum refers to a formation in rugby where players huddle closely together with their heads down while trying to gain possession of the ball.
The purpose of the rugby scrum is for each player on the team to play their role in order to work together and achieve their shared goal.
Scrum refers to a football team’s huddle.
